scope_warning: AQ/T 3046-2013 clause 1 excludes long-distance pipelines when used alone; only components explicitly called by SY/T 6891.2 are adopted.
assumptions_and_limitations: complete rupture uses the initial two-sided adiabatic choked-flow solution and does not yet solve transient line-pack depletion
dispersion uses the AQ/T 3046 Pasquill-Gifford continuous plume; high-pressure near-field transition requires independent validation
horizontal jet fire uses the conservative radial worst-case orientation envelope
TNO explosion-source volume and source strength are explicit project inputs
Figure E.1 curve points are digitized and remain provisional until independently benchmarked
release_blockers: transient rupture blowdown and line-pack depletion benchmark
independent validation of digitized TNO Figure E.1 curves
approved production thermophysical, ignition, occupancy and congestion parameters
IR grid and leak-point convergence verification
